units.source_text: 落叶公主自从得了前太政大臣来信之后，对夕雾更加疏远。

en.t: Ever since Princess Ochiba received the letter from the former Chancellor, she had become even more distant toward Yugiri.

units.source_text: 夕雾则日夜焦灼惶惑，同时云居雁忧愁苦恨，与日俱深。

en.t: Yugiri, for his part, was anxious and bewildered day and night, while Kumoi no Kari’s sorrow and bitter resentment deepened with each passing day.

units.source_text: 夕雾的侧室藤典侍闻知此种消息，想道：

en.t: When Yugiri’s concubine, To no Naishi, heard this news, she thought:

units.source_text: “夫人曾说我是始终不可容赦的厌物，不料现在来了一个难于抗御的劲敌！”

en.t: “The lady once said I was a detestable person she could never forgive, yet now a powerful rival has appeared, one too hard to resist!”

units.source_text: 看她可怜，常常去信慰问。

en.t: Feeling sorry for her, she often sent letters to comfort her.
In one of those letters, there was a poem:
